Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Abhishek Kumar Shukla,Aklesh Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Sachin Yadav,G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Manju Rani Chauhan,J.
Heard Mr. Abhishek Kumar Shukla, learned counsel for the applicant, Mr. Sachin Yadav, learned
counsel for the opposite party no.2 and Mr. Satendra Tiwari, learned Counsel for the State.
The present application has been filed to quash the charge-sheet dated 20.06.2020 as well as entire
proceedings of Case No. 301 of 2021 (State Vs. Anil Kumar), arising out of Case Crime No. 149 of
2019, under Sections 498A, 323 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District
Gautam Budh Nagar, pending in the court of learned Civil Judge (Junior Division), F.T.C.-2,
Gautam Buddha Nagar, on the basis of compromise deed dated 18.10.2024.

Earlier an Application u/s 482 No.39625 of 2024 was filed by the applicant wherein this Court vide order dated 28.11.2024 directed the parties to appear before the Court concerned for verification of Anil Kumar vs State Of U.P. And

In compliance of the aforesaid order dated 28.11.2024, compromise between the parties has been verified vide order dated 09.12.2024 by ACJ/(J.D.)-II, Gautam Budd Nagar, in presence of the parties as well as their respective counsels.
Certified copy of the verification order has been annexed on page-61 of the application.
The compromise deed as placed before the Court concerned has also been annexed as Annexure-3 to this application.

Learned counsel for the applicants submits that since the compromise entered between the parties has been verified by the court below, the entire proceedings of the aforesaid criminal case may be quashed by this Court.

Learned A.G.A. for the State accepts that the parties have entered into a compromise and the copy of the same has also been enclosed along with verification order, he has no objection, if the proceedings in the aforesaid case are quashed.

This Court is not unmindful of the following judgements of the Apex Court:
(i). B.S. Joshi and others Vs. State of Haryana and Another; (2003)4 SCC 675,
(ii). Nikhil Merchant Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation; (2008) 9 SCC 677,
(iii). Manoj Sharma Vs. State and Others; (2008) 16 SCC 1,
(iv).

Accordingly, proceedings of charge-sheet dated 20.06.2020 as well as entire proceedings of Case No. 301 of 2021 (State Vs. Anil Kumar), arising out of Case Crime No. 149 of 2019, under Sections 498A, 323 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Gautam Budh Nagar,
